title: events: the stream is cards:done, and an absent cost stays absent (#2563, Johnny HOLD 4/10)
body:
events.Stream is cards:done, the stream record and ci already read; the event
fields are added to its entries, and the SQLite file is a fold of that one
stream, rebuildable from it, not a second record. An entry written before the
fields were added (no `event`) is counted as skipped, never guessed into ok/fail.

tokens_in, tokens_out and usd are *int64/*float64 on Event: nil writes no field,
FromFields leaves an absent field nil, the fold stores NULL (columns nullable, no
default), dump/report print a dash, and totals no longer COALESCEs usd to 0.
`nova-pulse event` writes a cost only when its flag was given. The test that
asserted zero is replaced by TestMissingCostStaysAbsentAndBadNumbersAreRefused,
plus TestTheStreamIsCardsDone, TestAMissingCostFoldsToNullNotZero and
TestEventWithoutACostWritesNoCostField.
